identity.says: a hop in the actor chain is missing or failed

mandate.says: the payment is outside what the principal authorised

scope.says: the agent was never granted this action

policy.says: the executor's own policy stops it

financial.says: the amount or pace is out of line

fraud.says: signals of takeover, injection or collusion

disputes.says: what came back after earlier payments

system.says: the protocol itself: replay, expiry, timeout

effects.deny: the authority refuses on this alone
effects.escalate: a person or the agent must change something before a yes
effects.note: recorded on the decision, does not move it on its own

human_unverified.says: no verified human behind the chain

human_assurance_below_policy.says: the human was verified below the level the policy asks for

operator_unverified.says: the operator has no KYB on record

agent_unregistered.says: the agent is in no registry the policy accepts

agent_unverified.says: the agent has no KYA on record

agent_key_rotated_recently.says: the agent's key changed inside the policy window

credential_vouched.says: a credential from another issuer was presented and recorded, not verified

credential_absent.says: nothing was presented to say who the actor is

origin_changed.says: the instance speaks from a different origin than its token

relay_mismatch.says: the relay named in the presentation is not the one that delivered it

mandate_absent.says: no mandate was presented for a payment the policy requires one for

off_mandate_category.says: the product class is outside the mandate

off_mandate_executor.says: the executor is outside the mandate

over_mandate_amount.says: the amount is above the mandate's ceiling

over_mandate_budget.says: the mandate's budget for the window is used up

intent_payment_mismatch.says: the declared goal and the payment do not agree

intent_counterparty_mismatch.says: the declared payee and the actual payee differ

po_mismatch.says: the purchase order does not match the payment

delegation_depth_exceeded.says: the chain is longer than the policy allows

scope_not_inherited.says: a hop holds more than the hop above it

separation_violation.says: one party fills two roles the policy keeps apart

action_not_granted.says: no tool or grant covers this action

action_outside_tools.says: the agent has tools, none covers this action

agent_unpublished.says: the agent has no approved version in this environment

blocked_counterparty.says: the payee is on the executor's block list

counterparty_not_allowed.says: the payee is not on the executor's allow list

category_not_allowed.says: the product class is not on the allowed list

rail_not_allowed.says: the rail is not one the policy permits

amount_over_cap.says: the amount is above the per-action cap

above_review_threshold.says: above the line where a person decides

pending_escalation.says: an earlier escalation for this actor is still open

amount_x_baseline.says: well above what this actor usually pays

amount_at_cap.says: at the ceiling of the mandate or policy

cumulative_over_budget.says: the window's budget would be exceeded

concentration.says: most of the window's spend goes to one payee

wallet_budget_exceeded.says: the wallet's budget would be exceeded

card_budget_exceeded.says: the card's budget would be exceeded

no_baseline.says: no history to compare against yet

cross_executor_burst.says: the actor is hitting several executors at once

takeover_signals.says: signals that the agent is not under its operator's control

injection_pattern.says: prompt injection markers in the intent

collusion_pattern.says: payer and payee look like the same party

device_new.says: a device not seen for this actor before

automation_signals.says: headless or automation signals in the session

first_use_of_rail.says: the actor has not paid on this rail before

first_use_of_product_class.says: the actor has not bought this class before

high_risk_product_class.says: a class that attracts fraud: gift cards, travel, crypto

high_risk_terms.says: terms in the intent that attract fraud

off_brief.says: the purchase is not part of the agent's brief

velocity_high.says: too many actions in the window

rate_cap_exceeded.says: the policy's rate cap for the window is used up

spend_cap_exceeded.says: the policy's spend cap for the window is used up

sanctions_hit.says: the payee matches a sanctions list

sanctions_adjacent.says: the payee is close to a sanctioned party

kyc_required_above_threshold.says: the amount needs a verified human by law

reporting_threshold.says: at or above a reporting threshold

counterparty_new.says: the payee is new to this actor

counterparty_young.says: the payee's account or address is days old

counterparty_unknown.says: nothing is known about the payee

dispute_rate_high.says: the payee's dispute rate is above the policy line

authority_timeout.says: no decision inside the budget; the executor failed closed

evidence_signature_invalid.says: a piece of evidence did not verify

evidence_hash_mismatch.says: evidence inline does not match its ref

evidence_unsupported.says: evidence of a type this authority does not read

evidence_expired.says: a piece of evidence is past its expiry

requester_signature_invalid.says: the query's signature did not verify

presentation_malformed.says: the presentation could not be read

nonce_consumed.says: the challenge nonce was already used

idempotency_replay.says: the same query was already decided; this is that decision

decision_expired.says: the decision is past its expiry

decision_superseded.says: a later decision replaced this one

shadow_mode.says: decided and logged, not acted on

superseded_by_review.says: a person re-decided this after an escalation

status.deny: the status of the first group in this order that has a code on the decision: system (its own status), compliance 451, identity 401, velocity 429, else 403
